quarterly_data.signal: Polar Data Centers is applying Vertiv's factory-built deployment model to the first 41 MW phase of its multiphase AI data center at its Heroya campus in Norway (scalable to 100 MW); Vertiv is supplying prefabricated power and thermal modules, Vertiv SmartRun overhead infrastructure and Vertiv SmartMod, supported by Vertiv Unify software.
quarterly_data.figure: first 41 MW phase, scalable to 100 MW
quarterly_data.quarter: Vertiv press release: Vertiv Targets Up to 30% More Cumulative AI Token Output in (10-21-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Vertiv and NVIDIA introduced at NVIDIA GTC Berlin an AI factory approach combining the NVIDIA Vera Rubin DSX AI Factory reference design and Omniverse DSX Blueprint with Vertiv SimReady power and cooling assets, integrated with Dassault Systemes' 3DEXPERIENCE platform, then Vertiv prefabricated solutions (OneCore, SmartRun). In Vertiv's modeled scenario, configuration and validation fall from about 30 days to three days (10x) and infrastructure deployment from about 90 days to 45 days (up to 50%), so productive capacity arrives about 10 weeks sooner and cumulative token output in the first 12 months is up to 30% higher at equal installed capacity (modeled; actual results will vary). Vertiv is also contributing SimReady OpenUSD assets of its power and cooling equipment to the SimReady Central Library on Hugging Face.
quarterly_data.figure: modeled: 30 to 3 days for configuration; 90 to 45 days for deployment; up to 30% more cumulative token output in 12 months
